summary: Top agent/agent-infra updates: Cloudflare Agents release, Anthropic Claude Code adds AGENTS.md, GitHub Copilot updates; cost/deployment operator threads and several MCP/eval/memory infra signals.

candidates.title: Cloudflare Agents 0.24.0 + related packages released
candidates.why_it_matters: Cloudflare pushed Agents and integrations (worker-bundler, voice-twilio) updates for agent runtime/deploy.

candidates.title: Anthropic Claude Code v2.1.277 adds AGENTS.md support
candidates.why_it_matters: Official Claude Code now reads AGENTS.md enabling standard agent configs and cross-tooling compatibility.

candidates.title: GitHub Copilot: weekly releases, code-review UX changes, model deprecation notice
candidates.why_it_matters: Copilot weekly updates plus model deprecation and improved code-review influence developer workflows and migration planning.

candidates.title: Dev.to: replaced Lovable with $5 VPS, Dokploy and single MCP gateway
candidates.why_it_matters: Operator walkthrough showing cost-saving VPS+MCP replacement for hosted agent product publishing workflow.

candidates.title: Dev.to: Serving Gemma 4 on an AMD MI300X (practical deployment and throughput)
candidates.why_it_matters: Step-by-step serving Gemma 4 on MI300X shows low-cost high-memory GPU hosting throughput and MCP tooling usage.

candidates.title: Vercel: WebMCP support added to mcp-handler
candidates.why_it_matters: Vercel adding WebMCP handler support expands hosting options for MCP-driven agent workflows.

candidates.title: @vercel/agent-eval npm (2.3.0) — agent testing sandbox framework
candidates.why_it_matters: Agent-eval provides a sandboxed eval framework for testing AI coding agents.

candidates.title: memcell-ai/cli: living memory for cross-vendor coding agents (repo only)
candidates.why_it_matters: Repo claims cross-vendor persistent memory and decision recall for coding agents — repo-only; needs corroboration.

candidates.title: MCPJam: first testing & eval platform for MCP servers (Show HN)
candidates.why_it_matters: A focused MCP evaluation platform could standardize MCP server testing and benchmarks.

candidates.title: OpenAI site page: hex-gpt-6-astra (promotional page found)
candidates.why_it_matters: OpenAI published a page that appears to reference hex/gpt-6/astra — needs changelog/context for product impact.

candidates.title: OpenAI Codex: releases (rust v0.155.1 and alphas)
candidates.why_it_matters: Codex repo published stable and alpha releases affecting local/rust runtimes for coding agents.

candidates.title: Cloudflare Developers: Session Recording inspector for logs, network and DOM
candidates.why_it_matters: New session recording inspection helps debugging and security triage for browser-run agent sessions.
